title: ehrharta thunbergii
intro: Ehrharta thunbergii, commonly known as Tufted Hairgrass, is a species of grass native to New Zealand. It has been traditionally used in medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, helping to relieve symptoms of fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Ehrharta thunbergii include its ability to reduce inflammation, exhibit antioxidant activity, and display antimicrobial and antifungal properties. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
